item.title: Trump's week in review: Nat'l Prayer Breakfast, TrumpRx, guidance on religious expression in public schools
item.description: Among the numerous events that transpired this week before the nation's focus shifted to a video clip negatively depicting the Obamas that was attached to the tail end of a video about voter fraud posted on the president's Truth Social account, the Trump administration carried out several decisive actions, some of which impact Christians and faith-based organizations. #Trump #NationalPrayerBreakfast #publicschools #religiousfreedom #healthcare

item.title: Super Bowl LX: 6 Christians playing in the big game
item.description: The New England Patriots and Seattle Seahawks have multiple players who publicly embrace their Christian faith and have not hesitated to praise Jesus both on and off the field. Here are six Christians who will be suiting up to play in Super Bowl LX at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California. #SuperBowlLX #NFL #SeattleSeahawks #NewEnglandPatriots #TreVeyonHenderson #DrakeMaye #StefonDiggs #JaxonSmithNjigba #ErnestJones #CooperKupp

item.title: Tim Allen 'humbled, enlightened and amazed' after 13-month 'no skimming' Bible journey
item.description: Fans and faith leaders alike are cheering actor Tim Allen over his plans to re-read the Bible after his journey from Genesis to Revelation. #TimAllen #Bible #SantaClause

item.title: 11 indicted in Chinese marriage fraud scam to gain US citizenship
item.description: Eleven individuals have been indicted in Florida for their alleged involvement in a conspiracy to arrange fraudulent marriages between U.S. citizens and Chinese nationals in order to obtain legal immigration status, according to the U.S. Attorney’s Office. #Florida #MarriageConspiracy #FraudulentMarriages #AmericanandChinese #immigration

item.title: Lawmakers gather for prayer, repentance in DC amid deep divisions: 'Holy desperation'
item.description: Lawmakers, including House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., and Sen. Ted Cruz, R-Texas, joined Christians from around the country earlier this week at the Museum of the Bible for a national day of repentance, while highlighting the plight of persecuted Christians worldwide. #FamilyResearchCouncil #MikeJohnson #TedCruz #TonyPerkins #AndrewBrunson #persecution

item.title: Top court to hear cases against Turkey labeling Christians ‘security threat’
item.description: The European Court of Human Rights has opened proceedings in 20 cases involving Christians barred from re-entering Turkey after being designated as national security threats. The individuals, mostly foreign residents, say they were denied entry or residence solely for peacefully practicing their faith. #EuropeanCourtofHumanRights #Christians #Trkiye #NationalSecurityThreats #Faith #ChristiansinTurkey

item.title: 3 Doors Down lead singer dies 'peacefully in sleep' from stage 4 kidney cancer
item.description: Brad Arnold, lead singer and founding member of the American rock band 3 Doors Down, died Saturday in his sleep at the age of 47 after being diagnosed with stage 4 kidney cancer, according to a statement by the band. #3DoorsDown #BradArnold #Obituary #AmericanRockBand #KidneyCancer #Prayer #Faith

item.title: This week in Christian history: St. Athanasius exiled; Cotton Mather dies
item.description: Events from this week in Christian history include the birth of Henry Venn, the exiling of Athanasius of Alexandria and the death of Cotton Mather. #Egypt #Arianism #Athanasius #CottonMather #HenryVenn #mission #Puritans

item.title: ERLC joins chorus of conservatives rebuking Trump post dehumanizing Obamas
item.description: A video reposted by President Donald Trump that depicted former President Barack Obama and former first lady Michelle Obama with the bodies of apes has drawn condemnation from across the political spectrum, including from prominent Christian conservatives and Republican members of Congress who have called the imagery dehumanizing and unacceptable. #Trump #Obamas #VideoMichelleObama #ChristianConservatives #Racism #ERLC #SBC #Evangelicals

item.title: Assyrian Christian community in Middle East 'doesn't have a chance of survival,' advocate warns
item.description: A religious freedom activist warns that the Assyrian Christian community in the Middle East "does not have a chance of survival” and offered sharp words of criticism at the sixth annual International Religious Freedom Summit, saying “the West has repeatedly failed Assyrian Christians." #Syria #Iraq #InternationalReligiousFreedomSummit #Yemen #Sudan
